input: Shortlist three caterers for the office end-of-year party

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The per-head or total catering budget is the single biggest filter — it immediately eliminates or includes entire tiers of caterers.
Whether this is drinks-and-nibbles, a sit-down dinner, a buffet, or a multi-course meal completely changes which caterers are appropriate and what to compare.
Headcount drives pricing quotes and logistics; dietary requirements (vegan, halal, allergies, etc.) determine which caterers can even be considered.
The venue location and whether it has a kitchen affects which caterers are eligible — some require on-site facilities, others are fully self-contained.
The event date sets the deadline for booking and determines caterer availability, which directly affects who can be shortlisted.
Cuisine style or theme (e.g., formal, street food, cultural, seasonal) shapes the search and signals company culture/tone.
Knowing what 'a good shortlist' means — e.g., lowest cost, best reviews, past corporate experience, sustainability credentials — determines how to rank and compare caterers.

gold.taskTitle: Shortlist three caterers for the office end-of-year party
gold.taskDescription: Research and narrow down three suitable catering options for the company's end-of-year celebration.

questions.title: What is the total or per-head catering budget?
questions.description: Establish the financial limit to filter caterers by pricing tier from the outset.

questions.title: What style of catering service do you need?
questions.description: Determine whether the event calls for a sit-down dinner, standing buffet, canapes and drinks, food stations, or another format.

questions.title: How many guests are expected to attend?
questions.description: Get the headcount so caterers can be assessed on capacity and so quotes are comparable.

questions.title: Are there dietary requirements the caterer must accommodate?
questions.description: Identify any vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher, or allergy-related needs that would disqualify certain caterers.

questions.title: Where is the venue, and does it have kitchen facilities?
questions.description: Location determines geographic availability of caterers; kitchen availability affects which service models are feasible.

questions.title: What is the date of the party?
questions.description: The event date sets the booking deadline and filters caterers by availability on that specific day.

questions.title: What cuisine style or theme are you going for?
questions.description: Understanding the preferred food style or party theme guides the search toward caterers who specialise in that niche.
